summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. 27/27 backend pytest tests pass (10 new: seed counts, FAQ CRUD, upload auth/MIME/size, file serve, plus 17 regression). Playwright UI confirmed: floating WhatsApp button visible on all 7 public routes (/, /viajes, /viajes/:id, /galeria, /sobre-mi, /faq, /contacto) and absent on /admin & /admin/login — bug FIXED. /faq renders [data-testid='faq-page'] with all 8 toggles (faq-toggle-0..7), nav-faq link present. /viajes shows 9 trip cards, /galeria shows 12 photos. Admin login works; dashboard exposes [data-testid='tab-faq'] and AdminFAQ lists all 8 seeded items with Edit/Delete controls and a 'Nueva pregunta' creator. AdminTrips 'Nuevo viaje' modal exposes trip-cover-btn / trip-cover-url / trip-cover-file. AdminGallery exposes gallery-img-btn. Real PNG upload via /api/admin/upload → /api/files/<id> round-trips returning 200 with image/* content-type and the original bytes (Emergent storage init succeeded).

minor.issue: Status string is whitelisted but not validated against enum (nuevo|contactado|confirmado|cancelado) — pre-existing from iter 1.
FAQInput has no max length on question/answer — long answers can be inserted unbounded.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> due to ve-dynamic instrumentation — cosmetic dev-tool noise, not from app code.
Date inputs use browser default mm/dd/yyyy picker instead of a shadcn Calendar component — pre-existing UX choice, low priority.

action_items: (Optional) Validate reservation status with an Enum/Literal in Pydantic.
(Optional) Replace native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar in AdminTrips modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is now ~790 lines and growing — recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, public, admin_trips, admin_faq, files) and a storage.py helper before next iteration.

init_storage() is synchronous (uses `requests`) and called inside an async route — for /api/admin/upload and /api/files/{id} this blocks the event loop on every upload/serve. Move to httpx.AsyncClient or wrap with run_in_threadpool for scale.

/api/files/{id} re-fetches the binary from Emergent storage on every request (no caching layer). For images this means a network hop per request even with Cache-Control. Consider streaming or a CDN-style redirect.
FAQ models duplicate fields between FAQInput and FAQItem; could use a single base model with inheritance like Trip/TripBase.
AdminFAQ modal: confirm the admin update path uses Authorization Bearer header (Bearer fallback works in get_current_admin) — verified via tests.
Mongo `_id` correctly excluded via projection on all reads ✓.
Bcrypt $2b$ hash + seed_admin idempotent ✓; CORS allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials=True remains overly permissive but is iter-1 carryover.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ runs in <8s. The Emergent object storage IS reachable from this preview env — upload/serve roundtrip works (TestUpload.test_upload_image_and_serve passes). If a future iteration removes EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from backend/.env, the upload test auto-skips via pytest.skip on 500. Admin dashboard tab data-testids: tab-viajes/tab-reservas/tab-galeria/tab-testimonios/tab-faq (first three may need a small post-mount delay to be queried). Trip cover upload: trip-cover-btn/trip-cover-url/trip-cover-file; gallery: gallery-img-btn. nav-faq lives in Navbar. WhatsAppButton is mounted exclusively inside PublicShell after Footer — never inside /admin routes.
rca of the issue: Floating WhatsApp button regression from iter 2 was caused by it being mounted at app root which got unmounted on /admin routes. Fix moves <WhatsAppButton /> inside PublicShell so it auto-mounts only on public-shell routes — verified visible on all 7 public routes and absent on /admin and /admin/login.
